The path has no freshness cache. The watcher’s own heartbeat scan only reads status logs, but a heartbeat review or repeated `fm-crew-state.sh` call can still incur this delay. Use a short-lived cached PR detail for repeated reviews, or set `FM_CREW_STATE_NO_FORGE=1` for callers that do not require fresh forge state. The default heartbeat starts at 600 seconds and backs off to 7200 seconds, so this is not a per-15-second polling cost.
